intro: Young Crocolisk Skin is a pliable reptile pelt harvested from juvenile crocolisks throughout the Wetlands. Prized by local tanners like James Halloran of Menethil Harbor, these softer hides are cured and exported to ports across Azeroth.

sections.t: Tanning and Trade in the Marshes
p: Menethil Harbor serves as a bustling hub of commerce along the western coast of Khaz Modan, exporting marshland goods to distant ports. Among the town's most lucrative exports are the cured hides processed by the harbor's resident tanner, James Halloran. While full-grown crocolisks yield thick, tough scales, their young provide softer, far more workable leather. Because these juvenile skins are delicate and in high demand, Halloran relies on local hunters and passing travelers to scour the boggy marshes just outside town to keep his curing racks stocked.
